data.title: SYMC Accelerates Growth with Four Strategic Drivers
data.description: BANGKOK – Symphony Communication Public Company Limited, or SYMC, has signalled a positive performance outlook for 2026, supported by a continued business recovery and sustained growth. The company is advancing four key Growth Drivers to capitalize on the AI, data centerand digital economy megatrends: accelerating its expansion in the enterprise market; enhancing network capacity to support the growth of AI and datacenters; expanding regional connectivity; and building stable, sustainable growth. These initiatives will enable SYMC to capture long-term opportunities arising from digital infrastructure and enterprise services.

data.title: Drone shot down by Nato over Lithuania
data.description: VILNIUS - North Atlantic Treaty Organisation (Nato) fighter jets shot down a drone over Lithuania, the Baltic state's president said Tuesday, in the latest security incident on the alliance's eastern flank during Russia's war with Ukraine.

data.title: Cambodia and Thailand begin UN-backed conciliation on maritime dispute
data.description: Foreign ​ministers of Cambodia and Thailand delivered opening statements on Tuesday at the first ​meeting of a UN arbitration ‌process to resolve a long-running maritime dispute between the two Southeast Asian neighbours.

data.title: US Supreme Court blocks Trump mail-in ballot restrictions
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The US Supreme Court dealt a major blow Monday to President Donald Trump's attempts to restrict mail-in voting before the November midterm elections, denying his request to lift an order halting the divisive plan.

data.title: New Zealand agencies missed red flags in child kidnapping case: inquiry
data.description: WELLINGTON - New Zealand authorities failed to act on prior warnings that a man who went on the run with his kids for four years had a stash of guns and fears he would kidnap his children, an inquiry into a case that drew global headlines found Tuesday.

data.title: Moulin Rouge! The Musical brings a  Belle Epoque love story to Bangkok
data.description: For an evening of dazzling spectacle, romance and iconic music, Thai theatre audiences can soon step into the glittering world of Paris with Moulin Rouge! The Musical, the stage adaptation of Baz Luhrmann's acclaimed 2001 film.

data.description: A historic collection of rare works by three sculptors from different generations are showcased during "The Spirit Of Sculptors", which is running at Museum Pier until Oct 23.

data.title: Leeds thrash Newcastle to go third in the Premier League
data.description: LEEDS (UNITED KINGDOM) - Leeds demolished Newcastle 4-1 to climb up to third in the Premier League table on Monday and inflict a punishing first defeat for Magpies boss Matthias Jaissle.

data.title: Thailand moves to end 'world waste bin' image
data.description: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin on Monday led a search operation targeting an illegal waste disposal network at Laem Chabang Port in Chon Buri, vowing to end Thailand's reputation as the world's waste bin.

data.title: Somchart seeks further delay
data.description: People's Party (PP) Phuket MP Somchart Techathavorncharoen has postponed giving testimony to the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) for a third time in a probe into the alleged use of nominees to hold property for foreign nationals in Phuket.

data.title: Taekwondo minus pain, plus the gain
data.description: There will be no head guards, no body protectors and no risk of a broken toe in this new event -- an Asian Games taekwondo bout with none of the physical contact.

data.title: Hudson picks strongest Asean Cup squad
data.description: The Football Association of Thailand (FAT) has announced a 23-man squad for the inaugural Fifa Asean Cup, which will be held in Indonesia later this month.

data.title: Klong Toey oil residue 'stable'
data.description: Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Monday that oil residue in drainage pipes in Klong Toey district had not increased significantly, while authorities worked to identify its source.

data.title: Cooperation 'key' to resilience
data.description: Asean must make better use of its combined market, deepen economic integration and ensure that smaller businesses share in regional growth if it is to remain competitive amid geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruption, business leaders told the 2026 World Knowledge Forum (WKF).

data.title: Fund proposes platform to tax online content creators
data.description: The Thai Media Fund has proposed creating a national platform to generate income and collect taxes from social media influencers and content creators.

data.title: BMA clarifies Jewish site role
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has clarified that its authority over a proposed Jewish Association of Thailand building in Sukhumvit Soi 22 is limited to building control, while permits for cemeteries or crematoria require applicants to have lawful rights over the land.

data.title: MoU signed to boost semiconductor job openings
data.description: The government on Monday signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to develop human resources for the semiconductor industry, targeting the training of 10,000 highly skilled manufacturing workers over five years.

data.title: US to fund subsea cable connect study
data.description: The US Trade and Development Agency announced funding on Monday for a feasibility study to develop a trusted trans-Pacific submarine cable system that connects Thailand, through neighbouring countries, to the United States.

data.title: Customs nets B4bn from online tax levies
data.description: The Customs Department has collected more than 4 billion baht in import duties and value-added tax (VAT) on foreign online purchases since the government began taxing imported goods from the first baht on Jan 1, exceeding its initial target.

data.title: Thailand seeks a 'true partner' role within Brics
data.description: NEW DELHI: Thailand is seeking to position itself as a "true partner" of Brics, using the grouping to deepen cooperation, diversify markets and pursue new opportunities across the Global South, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said.

data.title: Senator calls for tighter control over temple finances
data.description: A senator on Monday urged tighter financial controls and oversight of monks after more than 92 million baht was allegedly embezzled from an Ayutthaya temple.

data.title: EC refers 77 suspects to court
data.description: The Election Commission (EC) has voted to refer 77 suspects in the alleged Senate election collusion case to the Supreme Court's Election Cases Division for criminal proceedings, including 26 sitting senators.

data.title: Alarm over AI grows as divided US Congress struggles to act
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The US Congress returned from recess Monday facing urgent warnings that artificial intelligence could spin dangerously out of control -- and little agreement over whether, or how, Washington should intervene.

data.title: Trump says Ukraine, Russia agree not to hit energy targets
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump said Monday that Ukraine and Russia had agreed not to target each other's energy facilities, a day after he chastised Kyiv for hitting Russian oil refineries.

data.title: Trump blasts 'sick conspiracy' against AI as warnings mount
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump on Monday attacked what he called a "sick conspiracy" against artificial intelligence, dismissing calls for guardrails despite warnings that it threatens humankind.

data.title: Russia intensifies attacks seeking to intimidate Ukraine, Europe
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Russia has in recent weeks intensified attacks against civilian targets in Ukraine, seeking to drain Ukrainian morale and intimidate Kyiv's European allies at a time when Moscow believes it has the advantage in weapons production, analysts say.
